verdict.rationale: Salesforce documents an official MCP server (salesforcecli/mcp) and public APIs. It also documents AI that auto-syncs emails and events into the CRM, and Agentforce agents shown 'Updating opportunity' across the deal cycle. However, no evidence shows an agent actually turning email or meeting signals into stage and next-step updates through the API or MCP server. missing for 10: documented MCP/API tools for writing opportunity stage and next-step fields, explicit email/meeting-signal-to-deal-update workflow docs, hands-on or independent corroboration.
